native_prior_stamp_input.explanation: The safe ready run used this exact maintained canonical snapshot. The earlier baseline and blocked-proposal runs both used baseline-canonical.sssom.tsv.

comparison_scope: CultureMech ingredient and occurrence outputs and KG Mediadive nodes are comparison-only. The raw builder consumes MIM mapped YAML, the copied Claw residual and KG unified mapping, plus ontology label inputs.
limitations: Full ontology databases, CultureMech/KG source tables and full diagnostic candidate remain local; their exact hashes and original paths are preserved.
Native validation does not approve scientific identity, roles, components or every remaining synonym. Changed owner approvals are withdrawn through the native receipt chain.
